name: Parameters.different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul
summary: Different in the tower ℚ ⊂ K ⊂ E: different(E/ℚ) = different(E/K)·different(K/ℚ) = (relDifferentGen(P, s))·(√−d(P)).

steps.claim: The different of 𝓞_E over ℤ is the product of the different of 𝓞_E over 𝓞_K and (the image of) that of 𝓞_K over ℤ.
The first is (relDifferentGen(P, s)) (`relDifferent_spec` for z = zetaInt), the second (√−d(P)) (`different_eq_span_and_adjoin_c₀`); a product of principal ideals is principal.
